description: This file contains functions for authentication-related API calls, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with organization ID and email/password. It also handles encryption/decryption of tenant IDs and constructs fetch requests to backend endpoints.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with a given email, handling different response scenarios including success, not found (404), and errors.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
methods.description: Performs login with organization ID, email, and password. Handles encryption of the organization ID, constructs the request payload, manages response parsing, and handles errors.
